fat_pct.quote: Whole wheels of Taleggio, Quartirolo, Provolone and Casera, were purchased from local farms. The cheeses contained 27.5%, 28.2%, 26.9% and 33.8% fat, respectively, (Table S3, Supplementary Material) (IDF-International Dairy Federation, 1993)

ammonia.reason: Minimal deamination from short 5-30 day proteolysis despite high aw 0.97.

animal_barnyard.reason: Very low p-cresol/indole; pasteurized cow milk and clean thin rind, no smear flora.

bitter.reason: Low hydrophobic peptides from rennet; short ripening prevents accumulation.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti, no methyl ketones 2-heptanone/2-nonanone formed.

browning.reason: High moisture and low free amino acids limit Maillard; residual lactose low.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from citrate fermentation by Streptococcus thermophilus/Lactococcus starter.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Low butanoic/hexanoic acids from limited native lipase and short ripening, no added lipase.

creaminess.reason: 51.1% fat-in-dry-matter plus 64.7% moisture gives lubricating fat-water emulsion.

crumbliness.reason: Low pH 4.27 near casein isoelectric point demineralizes micelles causing friable fracture.

firmness.reason: 64.7% moisture uncooked rennet curd with open hydrated protein network.

floral_honey.reason: Trace phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine catabolism, masked by acidity.

fruity.reason: Trace ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from LAB esterification of FFA with ethanol, limited by young age.

goaty.reason: Cow milk lacks goat branched 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic acids.

malty_nutty.reason: Minimal Strecker 3-methylbutanal/2-methylbutanal due to short aging and low proteolysis.

melt.reason: High moisture young casein flows on heating; low pH slightly limits but does not prevent flow.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Trace 1-octen-3-ol from linoleic acid oxidation; no surface mold.

oil_off.reason: Uncooked young protein matrix entraps 28.2% fat, minimal free oil on heating.

smoky.reason: No smoking step, no guaiacol/syringol deposition.

sour_vinegar.reason: High lactic acid ~16074 mg/kg plus acetic 844 mg/kg from LAB, pH 4.27-4.5.

stretch.reason: Not pasta-filata, no hot-water kneading or aligned casein; curd fragments.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Low methional/DMS; only slight pasteurization heat note, curd not cooked.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose/galactose and milky fat perceived sweet despite lactic acidity.

umami.reason: Low free glutamate from limited rennet/plasmin proteolysis in 2-4 week cheese.
